contexts: Six medical and oncology wards, 600-bed teaching hospital
Template live in the February 2027 release
Internal grant and 6 analyst hours per month
reading: Prompts and templates reliably increase the number of notes, but the conflict between the before-after and content-analysis studies shows that the number of notes and the quality of conversations can come apart. Training and feedback may be what separates the two. A trial would depend on outcomes the hospital has never measured: a quality score, goal-concordant care and family reports. Before a stepped-wedge trial, the hospital needs to know whether these can be measured and whether the intervention can be delivered.

nodes.label: Documented conversations
nodes.detail: Rose from 18 to 41 percent in a randomised trial (claim c1).

nodes.label: Bereaved families
nodes.detail: One third respond to a postal questionnaire (claim c5).

summary: Map separates the number of notes from their quality and shows the unmeasured outcomes a trial would need.
